templates.name: Cold Open Silhouette
templates.direction: The artist stands motionless in silhouette against a hazy backlight; on the first vocal they step forward into a soft key light.
templates.camera: Static wide, slow push-in on the step
templates.light: Hard backlight, haze, soft key on the reveal
templates.whenToUse: Mysterious or confident songs that open with a sparse intro.

templates.name: City Wake-Up
templates.direction: Dawn over the city: an empty street, a shop shutter rolling up, then the artist walking out of a doorway pulling on a jacket.

templates.name: Studio Voice-Note
templates.direction: Inside a small studio the artist presses record on a phone, hums the melody, laughs, and the beat drops in.

templates.name: Car Interior Monologue
templates.direction: Night drive: the artist in the passenger seat, street lights sliding across the face, speaking the first line to the window.

templates.name: Crowd Roar Build
templates.direction: A packed venue chanting the artist's name in darkness; a single spotlight finds the empty mic.
templates.camera: Wide from the back of the crowd

templates.name: Letter on the Table
templates.direction: Macro on a handwritten letter and a ring on a wooden table; a hand picks up the ring as the piano starts.

templates.name: Village Morning
templates.direction: Smoke from a cooking fire, children running, an elder nodding as the artist walks through the compound.

templates.name: Mirror Prep
templates.direction: Backstage mirror: the artist fixes their collar, meets their own eyes, and breathes out.

templates.name: Rain on Glass
templates.direction: Rain streaks a window; behind it the artist sits on a bed looking out, unmoving.

templates.name: Church Doors
templates.direction: Heavy church doors swing open onto a choir mid-hum; the artist walks up the aisle.

templates.name: Phone Screen Story
templates.direction: A phone screen lights up with a message; the thumb hovers, deletes, types again; the artist's face lit by the screen.
templates.light: Screen glow in a dark room

templates.name: Dance Floor Hush
templates.direction: A dance floor freezes mid-move as the music cuts; the artist walks through the frozen dancers.

templates.name: One-Light Performance
templates.direction: The artist performs the verse to camera in a dark room lit by one bare bulb swinging gently overhead.

templates.name: Rooftop Golden Hour
templates.direction: Performance on a rooftop at golden hour, the city behind, wind in the clothes.

templates.name: Living-Room Session
templates.direction: The band plays in a lived-in living room; the artist sings on the sofa arm, friends listening.

templates.name: Neon Alley
templates.direction: The artist walks and sings through a narrow alley of neon signs, steam rising from a grate.

templates.name: Market Chorus
templates.direction: The chorus erupts in a busy market: traders join in, a crowd forms and dances around the artist.

templates.name: Stairwell Echo
templates.direction: The artist sings in a concrete stairwell, voice echoing, light from a window high above.

templates.name: Car Bonnet Hang
templates.direction: Friends sit on car bonnets at a lookout over the city at night, the artist singing among them.

templates.name: Bedroom Dawn
templates.direction: Morning light through curtains; the artist sings sitting on an unmade bed, sheets around them.

templates.name: Warehouse Crew
templates.direction: The crew dances in an empty warehouse with one big light behind them, dust in the air.

templates.name: Beach Night Fire
templates.direction: A bonfire on the beach at night, friends around it, the artist singing and the waves behind.

templates.name: Studio Live Take
templates.direction: The full band records live in a studio, the artist in a booth, everyone watching each other through the glass.

templates.name: Rain Street Performance
templates.direction: The artist sings in the middle of an empty street in pouring rain, unmoving, as cars pass slowly.

templates.name: Barber Shop Verse
templates.direction: The artist raps from the barber chair, the barber working, the shop reacting to the lines.

templates.name: Wedding Dance
templates.direction: A wedding reception: the couple on the dance floor, the artist singing among the guests.

templates.name: Field of Grass
templates.direction: The artist walks through tall grass at sunset, fingertips brushing the tops.

templates.name: Mirror Room
templates.direction: The artist performs surrounded by mirrors, the reflections multiplying every move.

templates.name: Fade to Silhouette
templates.direction: The artist walks away into the backlight until only the silhouette remains, then the light fades.

templates.name: Empty Stage
templates.direction: The crowd has gone; the artist sits alone on the edge of the stage, mic beside them, and smiles.

templates.name: Morning After
templates.direction: Sunlight in the room the party was in; the artist picks up a cup, laughs to themselves, opens the curtains.

templates.name: Hands Apart
templates.direction: Two hands slowly let go of each other; one stays in frame.

templates.name: Drive Into the Dawn
templates.direction: The car drives away down an empty road toward the sunrise.

templates.name: Final Look to Lens
templates.direction: The artist looks into the lens for a long moment, a small nod, and the frame cuts to black.

templates.name: Credits Over Behind-the-Scenes
templates.direction: Behind-the-scenes clips: laughter, mistakes, the crew hugging, while the instrumental plays out.

templates.name: Choir Final Hold
templates.direction: The choir holds the last chord, the artist with arms open, the light rising to white.

templates.name: Problem in Two Seconds
templates.direction: Open on the problem the product solves, shown in one relatable moment with a frustrated sigh.

templates.name: Product Drop
templates.direction: The product drops into frame onto a clean surface with a satisfying thud.

templates.name: Question to Camera
templates.direction: A presenter looks into the lens and asks the question every viewer is thinking.

templates.name: Before-and-After Split
templates.direction: A split screen: life before on one side, after on the other.

templates.name: Unexpected Moment
templates.direction: Something surprising happens in an ordinary scene (a spill, a laugh, a surprise visitor) and the product saves the day.

templates.name: Sound-On Hook
templates.direction: A strong sound (a can opening, a sizzle, a beat drop) with a close-up of its source.

templates.name: Demo on the Counter
templates.direction: Hands demonstrate the product on a kitchen counter, step by step, close and clear.

templates.name: Day-in-the-Life Montage
templates.direction: Three quick moments across a day with the product naturally present in each.

templates.name: Street Interview
templates.direction: A presenter asks people in the street to try the product; real, varied reactions.

templates.name: Expert at Work
templates.direction: A professional (chef, nurse, engineer) uses the product while working and explains why.

templates.name: Family Table
templates.direction: A family shares a meal; the product is passed around; conversation and laughter.

templates.name: Hero Packshot
templates.direction: The product on a plinth turning slowly, light raking across the label.

templates.name: Customer Story
templates.direction: A customer at home or at work tells what changed, cut with shots of them living it.

templates.name: Packshot and Logo
templates.direction: The product centred on a clean background, the logo and offer appearing beside it.

templates.name: Smile and Call to Action
templates.direction: The presenter smiles, says the call to action, and points to where the link appears.

templates.name: Shopfront Reveal
templates.direction: The camera pulls back to reveal the shop or venue with people walking in.

templates.name: Community Close
templates.direction: Everyone from the ad turns to the camera together, smiling, as the logo appears.

templates.name: Tagline on Black
templates.direction: Cut to black with the tagline, then the logo, a single sound accent.
